'''Randar Dowellin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] with a unique collection of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] artifacts, including a rare [[Karltonian Fiskin]] [[Coin/Legends|coin]]. The collection was tagged with a special chemical tracer.<ref name="FC" />

After the collection was stolen by the [[Bon Seqours]], Dowellin sent [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to track down the collection, which led them to the [[Farrimmer Cafe]] on the [[Mynock 7 Space Station]].<ref name="FC" />
